definitions.gloss: viewpoint, perspective, way of looking at something
definitions.explanation: A particular attitude or manner of considering something; one's perspective or point of view.
The method of reading or understanding something like a chart, map, or document.

examples.japanese: {物事|ものごと}の{見方|みかた}は{人|ひと}によって{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Perspectives on things differ from person to person.

examples.japanese: {見方|みかた}を{変|か}えてみよう。
{地図|ちず}の{見方|みかた}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please teach me how to read a map.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{見方|みかた}を{提案|ていあん}する。

notes:
HOMOPHONE:
・{味方|みかた} (ally, supporter) - different kanji

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{見方|みかた}を{変|か}える (to change one's perspective)
・〜の{見方|みかた} (way of looking at ~)
・{見方|みかた}によっては (depending on how you look at it)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{見方|みかた} vs. {観点|かんてん} vs. {視点|してん}
  - {見方|みかた}: general word for viewpoint
  - {観点|かんてん}: standpoint (more formal)
  - {視点|してん}: point of view (often used in analysis)
